name: hbm_su_cx_ijq_1018w

pin_regs.reason: Every pin is registered in RTL (inputs land in pin registers / banks, every output is a register); a wrapper stage would move the fixed 3:4 seam calendar edges.

structural_change: CX-IJ 10-18: the two-root ij leaf carries two 3:4 crossings inside one leaf (ijd_slot clk_s -> ipv / ipgb / ibad clk_q, and io_slot clk_q -> idl clk_s, 3 x 1,024 b), the defect that failed routes hbm_su_cx_dl_1017-s2-761317600 (TT -166.7 / FF -95.1) and hbm_su_cx_rc_1017-s2-761317600 (TT -173.4 / FF -77.9): related-clock STA times a 3:4 crossing at the VCO tick (setup 277.8 ps, coincident-edge hold) less the 150 / 100 distinct-entry reserve. Fix (dl/rc split, S81 x34 _s/_t precedent): one root per half; the crossings become 2-bank seams (static calendar windows >= 3 quanta for setup and rewrite-after-read), die-level 3:4 seam arcs. Lockstep vs the hub on Verilator 5.050 PASS QID 2 and QID 0 (checks=24183); mutants 1/2/3/4 FAIL. ij_q (serial, x1 per quarter): E seam to ij_s 2,114 b (5.6/um); the four slices port-5 data 4,096 b on W (inj_q0/1, 5.4/um), S (inj_q2, 4.9/um) and N (inj_q3, 4.9/um, clock/reset/fault at the NE end beside the ob seam banks). HH-1 10-18 regate: 388.8 x 388.8 -> 216 x 388.8 (gate 388.8^2: pin flops ring a 389 um square, TT / FF pin-flop spread 97.2 / 92.7 ps > 80, util 2.7%); the ring now spans 216 x 389 um. Variant u: unclustered TritonCTS H-tree over the pin-band sinks (qkd_d2d_static 10-15 precedent: sparse pin-band tile, unclustered tree 442..508 ps). RE-PLAN TW2-CXIJ 10-19 (route hbm_su_cx_ijq_1018-x1-ac1057e3b + gates ijq/ijq_u: trial GRT needed 5/30 extra congestion iterations, total wire 1,549 mm in 216x388.8, M3 45%/M2 33% vs M4/M5 10%/9%): the wire is the 16->4 chunk gather itself (each of 4,096 inj bits feeds the 4 output quarters 45 um apart on E, each iword bit feeds ob0[i] and ob1[i] 182 um apart), and placement packed it into ONE diagonal band (the ob0/ob1 midpoints, ~0.5 bin density) plus a 4-column E pin-flop band at density >= 1.0 (2,048 ob flops at 5.4 pins/um). Fix: unclustered CTS (u: TT/FF spread 33.1/33.3), E/W pin-flop bands 8 columns deep (half the density), gather band spread by routability-driven global placement (GPL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN on, pd 0.50; ports, faces, outline, RTL and the 324x388.8 pair unchanged).

job.purpose: HBM die d4g cxport one-root half: ot_hbm_su_static_cxport_ij_q (re-plan w: congestion; submit only one passing variant)

reroute_reason.what: congestion re-plan of the first ij_q route hbm_su_cx_ijq_1018-x1-ac1057e3b, which went EARLY_FAIL_DRC 10-19 06:15 (DRT stuck at 168 violations, best 137, after 41 iterations; no closed ij_q view; same RTL/ports/faces/outline). DRT report rpt-40: all 143 markers in ONE interior 28x37 um window (x 116-144, y 152-189) = the dense diagonal gather band (M2 EOL/short 74, M3 spacing/short 44, M4 23; none at pin faces or corners); its trial GRT needed 5/30 extra iterations, M3 45%/M2 33% vs M4/M5 10%/9%
reroute_reason.why: the 16->4 chunk gather was packed into one ~0.55-density band at the ob0/ob1 midpoints. Fix: routability-driven global placement spreads the band to ~0.3 bin density (gate w: trial GRT overflow 0, 1 extra iteration vs 5), unclustered CTS (TT/FF pin-flop spread 33.9/33.2 ps), 8-column pin-flop bands. Base change retained: one-root split of the two-root leaf hbm_su_cx_ij_1017 (CX-IJ 10-18; 3:4 crossings become 2-bank seams)
